verdict: Leads collapsed this week; the cause is confirmed and being fixed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 81 leads at an average cost of $8.52 per lead — a healthy pace through most of the period. However, the last six days (September 10–15) produced zero leads, confirming a delivery failure in the primary Meta campaign rather than normal fluctuation. Separately, 81 inquiries entered your pipeline this period but zero converted to booked appointments, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up — not an issue with the ads themselves. Ad delivery is being corrected this week, and the intake follow-up process is under active review alongside it. You should expect lead volume to recover toward prior weekly levels as these fixes take hold.

watch_item.issue: Meta ad delivery stopped producing leads six days ago, and organic search and Google Business engagement dropped in the same window, compounding the shortfall.
watch_item.fix: The primary campaign is being reviewed and corrected this week to restore delivery; the intake pipeline is also being audited to ensure leads that do arrive are reached promptly.
